command:
set -euo pipefail
listeners="$(lsof -nP -iTCP:46327 -sTCP:LISTEN)"
printf "%s\n" "$listeners"
[[ "$listeners" == *"100.64.0.14:46327 (LISTEN)"* ]]
[[ "$listeners" != *"*:46327 (LISTEN)"* ]]
body_file="$(mktemp)"
trap "rm -f \"$body_file\"" EXIT
for host in 100.64.0.14 sweetmac14.sweet.home; do
  for route in / /main.tsx /api/v1/live-snapshot?request=1; do
    code="$(curl --noproxy "*" -sS -o "$body_file" -w "%{http_code}" "http://$host:46327$route")"
    printf "allowed Host %s route %s -> %s\n" "$host" "$route" "$code"
    [[ "$code" == "200" ]]
  done
  rg -q "\"source\":\"loop-registry-live\"" "$body_file"
done
for route in / /main.tsx /api/v1/live-snapshot?request=1; do
  code="$(curl --noproxy "*" -sS -H "Host: 100.64.0.15:46327" -o "$body_file" -w "%{http_code}" "http://100.64.0.14:46327$route")"
  rg -q "\"code\":\"HOST_REJECTED\"" "$body_file"
  printf "unrelated numeric Host route %s -> %s, exact rejection body\n" "$route" "$code"
  [[ "$code" == "403" ]]
done
